title: Dalton Saffe
description: Dalton Saffe is an artist & software engineer based in Brooklyn, NY. Since their teen years in Miami, they've been painting, shooting photos, DJing, producing music, and throwing events. They studied graphic design at the School of Visual Arts and worked in the service industry and as an apprentice naturopath before teaching themself to code in 2017 and attending Fullstack Academy in 2018. Since then, they've worked as a full-stack engineer at design agencies, start-ups, Leafly, and Trade Coffee.
emailListBlurb: Occasional updates on new art and blog posts :)
